body.x: HOLLYWOG(www.neubac.com) announced its new wireless remote controlled device for back pain 'Neubac' at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
'Neubac' is the first wireless remote controlled pain relief device utilizing TENS technology to specifically treat back pain.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500~3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
